prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1233; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving care for them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you disclose the full policy limits of liability coverage under the policy that applies to the other driver involved in this collision, along with a copy of the declarations page. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether any excess or umbrella coverage may apply.

Please ensure that all evidence relating to this incident is preserved. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or vehicle data, dash camera footage, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any communications with the other driver or witnesses. Routine deletion or destruction of these materials must be suspended until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
